# JUDO Generator Commons

> Template-based code generation framework that transforms meta-models into code using Handlebars templates and SpringEL expressions, providing checksum validation, generator ignore patterns, and incremental generation.

Key facts:
- Language: Java 21
- Build tool: Maven 3.9.4, single module, OSGi Bundle packaging
- Main technologies: Handlebars 4.4.0, Spring Expression Language 6.2.7, Jackson YAML 2.17.2, ClassGraph 4.8.152
- Used by JUDO meta-model generators (ESM, PSM, UI)
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams and usage examples
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Comprehensive AI agent instructions covering architecture, workflows, helpers, YAML descriptors, and troubleshooting
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines and development setup

## Core Generation

- [ModelGenerator.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ModelGenerator.java): Central orchestrator — generateToDirectory(), writeDirectory(), checksum management
- [ModelGeneratorContext.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ModelGeneratorContext.java): State container with Handlebars engine and SpringEL evaluation context
- [GeneratorModel.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorModel.java): YAML-based template collection with override mechanism
- [GeneratorTemplate.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorTemplate.java): Single template configuration (path, factory, condition expressions)
- [GeneratorParameter.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorParameter.java): Builder-pattern configuration for generation runs
- [TemplateEvaulator.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/TemplateEvaulator.java): SpringEL expression evaluation for templates

## Template System

- [ChainedURLTemplateLoader.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ChainedURLTemplateLoader.java): Parent-child template loading with .override.hbs support
- [TemplateHelperFinder.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/TemplateHelperFinder.java): ClassGraph-based @TemplateHelper annotation scanning
- [StaticMethodValueResolver.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/StaticMethodValueResolver.java): Base class for helper classes with method caching
- [ThreadLocalContextHolder.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ThreadLocalContextHolder.java): Thread-safe context access for parallel template generation

## Annotations

- [TemplateHelper.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/annotations/TemplateHelper.java): Marks helper classes for auto-discovery
- [ContextAccessor.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/annotations/ContextAccessor.java): Signals bindContext(Map) availability for thread-local access

## Utilities

- [ChecksumUtil.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ChecksumUtil.java): MD5 hash calculation for incremental generation
- [GeneratorIgnore.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorIgnore.java): GLOB-based file exclusion (.generator-ignore)
- [ChecksumIgnore.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ChecksumIgnore.java): Checksum validation override (.generator-checksum-ignore)
- [GitIgnoreSynchronizer.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GitIgnoreSynchronizer.java): Auto-updates .gitignore with generated file entries
- [UriHelper.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/UriHelper.java): URI manipulation utilities
- [StringHelper.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/StringHelper.java): String transformation Handlebars helpers

## Data Models

- [GeneratedFile.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratedFile.java): Single generated file (path, content, permissions)
- [GeneratorFileEntry.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorFileEntry.java): Persisted checksum entry (path, checksum)
- [GeneratorResult.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorResult.java): Generation result container with actor-based discriminators

## Tests

- [ModelGeneratorTest.java](src/test/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ModelGeneratorTest.java): File writing, checksums, gitignore synchronization tests
- [GeneratorIgnoreTest.java](src/test/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/GeneratorIgnoreTest.java): GLOB pattern matching and hierarchy tests
- [ChecksumIgnoreTest.java](src/test/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/generator/commons/ChecksumIgnoreTest.java): Checksum ignore pattern tests
